name: Dublin
summary: Dublin has become Europe's technology hub, with European headquarters for Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Stripe and Airbnb, creating a very active digital nomad and expat community. It is one of the most expensive cities in Europe: rent is extremely high and the housing shortage is a real problem for those who arrive without a prior contract. The oceanic climate is mild but very rainy and unpredictable, although the internet is fast and reliable and the Irish culture makes social life very easy.
